e: Experimental postdoc on superconducting and magnetic quantum-material thin films and interfaces, using tunnel-diode resonators, magneto-optical imaging and NV magnetometry to find what causes dissipation and decoherence in transmon qubits. The posting says the hire must obtain and maintain government access authorization and must disclose foreign-government-sponsored activities under DOE O 486.1A; it gives no explicit citizenship requirement.
f: Ames National Laboratory (Iowa State University), Division of Materials Science and Engineering
